neighbours.label: the digit right after a capital D in a code-like name (D1, D2, D3, D-10), across vitamins, cameras, sports divisions and models
fire: Most supplements now contain vitamin D3 in a small soft capsule.
She played D1 tennis before she went to medical school.
He sold his old Canon and bought a Nikon D2 from a friend.
The gun on the tank was a D-25T, later replaced by a newer one.
Mushrooms contain vitamin D2 when they are grown in sunlight.
Our college moved up from D3 to a higher sports league last year.
We rolled a D6 for damage and a D20 to hit.
The D1 team flew to Texas for the opening game.
